== Ajahs ==

I would like to change the <nowiki>[[Category:Aes Sedai]]</nowiki> tag in each ajah to force them to sort to the same letter under the category, and thus force them together regardless of the color. Either by changing it to <nowiki>[[Category:Aes Sedai|Ajah, White]]</nowiki> (which would move them all to A) or <nowiki>[[Category:Aes Sedai|*White]]</nowiki> (which would move them all before A and after the title article) for the White Ajah, and similar changes to each of the other 7 (including Black) Ajahs.  However I hesitate to make this change without additional opinions on the change itself, and which of the two is a better approch (I lean to "*White" over "Ajah, White" I also lean to forcing Black Ajah to the end of the Ajah list ("*ZBlack")). --[[User:Melriken|Melriken]] 23:18, 6 February 2008 (UTC)
